# lsmrust_access_key (Resource)

An access key for a database. The secret is returned by the control plane only once, at creation, and is kept in Terraform state from then on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lsmrust_access_key" "app" {
  database_id = lsmrust_database.orders.id
  scopes      = ["read", "write"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) ID of the database this key grants access to. Changing it creates a new key.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Permissions granted to the key: any of `read`, `write`, `admin`. Order does not matter. Can be changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control-plane identifier of the access key.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The key's secret. Only available when the key is created; it is null for imported keys.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The secret is only returned at creation, so it is null for imported keys.
terraform import lsmrust_access_key.app key-0123456789ab
```
